info.title: Cloudbrowser REST API
info.description: Next.js API with Chrome on Fly Sprites, PostgreSQL and Auth0. Billing endpoints require configured Stripe; check billingEnabled. API-key authentication remains supported. The Go CLI manages browsers and links; lifecycle polling is handled internally. Fork requires a paused source.

post.description: Reserves a preinstalled Sprite and a concurrent slot atomically. Returns an operation. If the prepared pool is empty, returns HTTP 503 browser_capacity_preparing. Links can be created before the browser is running. Connecting requires a running browser.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays with the same payload return the same operation. Different payload returns 409.

delete.description: Revoke all grants and stop connections. Deletion is terminal.

patch.description: Owner workspace only. Save auto-pause immediately. Re-enabling grants a fresh 5-minute connection window. Returns 409 while pausing or deleting. Never resumes a browser.

post.description: Pause disconnects active transports and invalidates runtime viewer sessions/tickets. CDP and reusable Live View links remain valid. After resume reconnect with the same URL. Chrome profiles persist; live page memory is not guaranteed. No implicit resume on access. Pause flushes Chrome profile writes before requesting provider pause. Owners can retry pause for a failed browser with a previous runtime. Admission immediately sets browser status to pausing. Operation success requires the provider to confirm paused; HTTP 202 alone is not completion.

Pause disconnects active transports and invalidates runtime viewer sessions/tickets. CDP and reusable Live View links remain valid. After resume reconnect with the same URL. Chrome profiles persist; live page memory is not guaranteed. No implicit resume on access. Pause flushes Chrome profile writes before requesting provider pause. Admission immediately sets browser status to resuming. Operation success requires a new running runtime generation and responsive desktop/CDP services; reconnect only after success. HTTP 202 alone is not completion.

Owner workspace only. Requires a running browser or a failed browser with an existing runtime. Force-stops Chrome and starts it again on the same Sprite, keeping its saved profile, downloads and grants. Unsaved work and in-memory state can be lost. Existing sessions disconnect. The operation reapplies the network policy and waits for a new generation with healthy desktop and CDP endpoints. Compute allowance and concurrency apply.

Copies a paused source profile into an independent preinstalled Sprite. The child receives its own browser ID. Create access grants for the child as needed. A running source returns 409 pause_required. An empty prepared pool returns HTTP 503 browser_capacity_preparing. Multiple forks can share a paused source. Resume or deletion of the source returns 409 busy until its forks finish. Completed children can be operated independently.

post.description: Create a permanent browser-scoped link, valid until revoked. CDP provides full control. Live View requires sign-in and defaults to read-only. URLs survive pause/resume; runtime connections must reconnect. The URL is returned on creation and can be revealed again by the owner; listings never expose it.
post.x-cli: cloudbrowser links create br_123 --audience cdp --name research --output json

get.description: List metadata only, never bearer URLs, share secrets, refresh cookies or entry tickets. Live View metadata includes permission, expiresAt (null for never), lastOpenedAt, activeSessions and revision. Filter by audience/status; paginate with cursor/limit. Local implementation returns all matching entries with nextCursor=null; pagination is pending.

delete.description: Permanently revoke this grant, close its streams, and invalidate all tickets and refresh families. Reusable URL can no longer create sessions. Idempotent; revoked grants cannot be revived. Does not delete the browser.

patch.summary: Change a Live View share link policy
patch.description: Change link name or Live View permission. Policy updates invalidate existing viewer sessions. Only the owner can manage links.
patch.x-cli: cloudbrowser links update br_123 grant_123 --permission view

post.description: Consume an account-authorized, runtime-bound ticket once and issue short-lived HttpOnly viewer session cookies. Requires exact Origin and browser binding; rejects revoked source grants, changed permissions and inactive runtimes. Link authorization persists until revoked; session credentials refresh internally. No workspace key or anonymous sharing access is accepted.

200.description: Credentials are returned only via HttpOnly Set-Cookie; invalid/consumed tickets return 401.

post.description: Rotate short-lived viewer cookies with reuse detection. Reject revoked sessions, inactive grants, changed revision/runtime or expired idle deadline. Internal session refresh requires no CLI process. Reopen through the authenticated account library after session inactivity. Does not widen permissions.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Non-secret session ID returned by exchange; matching cookies still required.

200.description: Credentials are returned only via HttpOnly Set-Cookie; invalid/consumed tickets return 401.

post.description: End only the current viewer session, revoke its refresh family and close streams; clear cookies using the exact browser-specific path. Does not revoke the share URL: the accepted account can reopen its saved browser for a new session. Direct one-time tickets remain consumed. Missing/expired cookies are cleared and return 200. Closing a page alone is not reliable logout. Use isolated viewer origin, no-store/no-referrer, strict CSP, same-origin credentials, exact Origin/CSRF checks and redacted logs. Check current link authorization, permission, revision, runtime and issuer access on every request and stream. Never accept a workspace API key here. Validate the recipient’s active account/membership as well as the owner’s source grant. Removal from the recipient library invalidates that recipient’s sessions only. Local cookies are independently named per viewer session (cb_access_{sessionId}, cb_refresh_{sessionId}) and omit Secure on localhost HTTP. No anonymous account authorization.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Non-secret session ID returned by exchange; matching cookies still required.

get.summary: List a link’s authorized viewer sessions
get.description: Workspace authorization required. Return metadata only; no cookies, tokens or private page content. Expired/ended sessions are excluded. Local implementation returns all matching entries with nextCursor=null; pagination is pending.

delete.summary: End all sessions for a Live View link
delete.description: Workspace authorization required. Invalidate all current sessions, refresh families and outstanding entry tickets; close streams. The reusable share URL stays valid for future visits. Use revokeGrant to prevent future visits too. Does not operate on CDP.

get.summary: List my owned and shared browsers
get.description: Signed-in account only. Owned and shared entries appear in one grid. A shared entry does not transfer ownership, create a browser, consume the recipient’s browser concurrency, or grant lifecycle/reshare/CDP rights. Every preview subscription rechecks current authorization. Unavailable entries may remain visible without streaming private contents. Compute remains on the owning workspace. Local implementation returns all matching entries with nextCursor=null; pagination is pending.

post.summary: Accept a shared browser into my account
post.description: Requires signed-in account and a valid invitation. Reusable share links can be accepted by multiple accounts. Direct one-time invitations atomically bind to the first accepting account; subsequent redemption receives 409, including by the same account; use the saved library entry instead. Validate link expiration, revocation, revision and owner authority before accepting. Save an account-to-browser access reference, not ownership or a raw bearer token. Deduplicate by account/browser and retain a specific authorized source grant; never silently widen rights. Existing owner entries remain owned. Accepted members can later request fresh viewer tickets without replaying the original invite. Entry ticket expiration does not expire accepted membership; parent-link expiration/revocation does. Return the canonical /browsers/{id} URL. A paused browser can be added but must not be resumed automatically.

delete.summary: Remove a shared browser from my library
delete.description: Remove only this recipient’s saved access relationship and end that recipient’s viewer sessions. Do not delete/pause the owner’s browser, revoke the public share link or affect other recipients. Reject owned entries; owner deletion uses the lifecycle API. Re-adding requires a valid reusable invite or new invite if one-time access was removed.

post.summary: Open an owned or saved shared browser
post.description: Account authorization required. Check ownership or saved membership AND its current parent grant permission, revision, expiration and issuer access; a saved list entry is not authority by itself. Browser must be running to stream; paused view shows an explicitly labeled authorized last frame without implicitly resuming. Mint a short-lived one-use runtime-bound ticket for the isolated viewer origin. The account shell passes only this ticket through a strict origin-checked handshake to the viewer, never its account cookie or workspace API key. Shared control grants no lifecycle, deletion, fork, reshare or CDP rights. Grid and fullscreen use this same authorization path; switching presentation alone does not duplicate runtime sessions.

get.description: Owner-only action. Returns the decrypted URL and, for CDP grants, the short prompt for an agent. List endpoints never return the bearer secret. Grants created before encrypted secret storage may return 409 secret_unavailable.

200.description: Owner link URL and optional agent prompt

get.x-cli: cloudbrowser links reveal br_123 grant_123 --output url

get.description: Owner workspace only. Reads the effective Sprite network policy without resuming compute. Shared access does not grant policy access. Unknown upstream rules are reported as unverified.

200.description: Requested policy, last confirmed effective policy and application status.

put.description: Owner workspace only. Requires Idempotency-Key; poll the returned operation until succeeded. Website connections can disconnect. Paused browsers stay paused. Resume, fork and further network changes wait for confirmation. Pause/delete can interrupt confirmation; resume enforces the requested policy before starting compute. Uncertain responses retry automatically; pending does not mean the requested policy is enforced.
put.x-cli: cloudbrowser network update BROWSER_ID --mode allow-list --domains example.com,*.example.org

ApiKey.description: Account/workspace API key. Distinct from a per-browser CDP token or viewer ticket.

ViewerAccess.name: __Secure-cb_viewer_access
ViewerAccess.description: Viewer-origin HttpOnly cookie; actual name is session-suffixed (cb_access_{sessionId} or cb_refresh_{sessionId}). Exact Origin is required. Local HTTP only omits Secure.

ViewerRefresh.name: __Secure-cb_viewer_refresh
ViewerRefresh.description: Viewer-origin HttpOnly cookie; actual name is session-suffixed (cb_access_{sessionId} or cb_refresh_{sessionId}). Exact Origin is required. Local HTTP only omits Secure.

AccountSession.name: __Host-cb_account
AccountSession.description: Signed-in account on cloudbrowser.tv; HttpOnly, Secure, host-only, SameSite=Lax; CSRF protection required. Not sent to viewer origin.

AccountAccess.description: User-account access token issued by human CLI login. Not a workspace API key, CDP token or viewer refresh token.

tabLimit.description: Per browser, across windows and clients. CDP Target.createTarget returns a protocol error containing tab_limit_reached when full.

tabCount.description: Current open pages on individual browser reads. Null while paused or temporarily unavailable.

pauseReason.description: Recorded reason for the most recent pause. Null for unknown historical reasons and shared viewers. Does not indicate whether resume is currently allowed.

pausedAt.description: Time the pause completed. Null while pausing, for older records or shared viewers.

autoPause.description: Automatically pause after 5 minutes without a live CDP or desktop connection, including Console previews. Disable for disconnected background tasks. Creating, resuming or re-enabling starts a fresh 5-minute window. Does not override billing limits.

network.description: Applied at claim time before website access. Defaults to allow-all without blocked domains.

startPaused.description: Paused forks do not reserve running capacity. They retain independent profile writes.

autoPause.description: Inherits the source browser setting when omitted.

liveViewUrl.description: Public account-shell entry URL, returned only at issuance: https://cloudbrowser.tv/view/{grantId}#share=... (reusable) or #ticket=... (one-time invitation). Sign in and accept into your library, then open /browsers/{browserId} fullscreen in the same workspace. Viewer transport remains isolated at view.cloudbrowser.tv. Raw secrets never appear in listings.

runningBrowsers.description: Running or reserved slots, including pending or uncertain operations.

period.description: UTC calendar month for Free; subscription billing period for paid plans.

computeBlock.description: Current billing restriction on starting/resuming compute, independent of historical browser pause reasons. Paid overage alone does not block compute. Concurrency admission is checked separately.

mode.description: New links are reusable. Existing one-time invitations retain their original claim rules.

permission.description: view is read-only: stream only, no mouse, keyboard, touch, clipboard writes, uploads, navigation commands or browser control. control allows browser interaction but no workspace, lifecycle or CDP administration. Enforced by the gateway, not just UI.

expiresAt.description: Null for permanent links. Legacy revoked links may retain their former deadline.

renewUntil.description: Legacy field, always null for permanent links.

autoRenew.description: Legacy field. No link renewal is needed; viewer credentials refresh internally.

hasSecret.description: Owner metadata: whether repeat-copy is available. The secret is never returned by list endpoints.

entryExpiresAt.description: Direct one-time URL only; null for reusable shares.

activeSessions.description: Current authorized viewer sessions, not connected socket count.

permission.description: view is read-only: stream only, no mouse, keyboard, touch, clipboard writes, uploads, navigation commands or browser control. control allows browser interaction but no workspace, lifecycle or CDP administration. Enforced by the gateway, not just UI.

authorizationExpiresAt.description: Absolute link authorization deadline, measured from issuance/update; null means no expiration. Applies to new visits AND all existing sessions. Automatic refresh never moves this deadline.

accountId.description: Recipient account binding; never infer identity from browserId alone.

ticket.description: Single-use opaque secret from the URL fragment. Never log it.

UpdateLiveViewGrant.description: Share-mode Live View only. At least one property required. Every effective policy change invalidates all old sessions and tickets immediately and increments revision. The same reusable URL can then open a fresh session. Revoked grants cannot be revived. An expired share may be extended by its owner, but previous sessions stay ended.

ticket.description: One-time secret minted after account/library authorization, bound to recipient account, browser, grant revision, permission and runtime. Return only on ticket issuance.

url.description: Isolated viewer URL carrying a single-use ticket in its fragment. The viewer clears the fragment before exchange.

shared.description: Owned browser has at least one currently active sharing grant.

pauseReason.description: Recorded reason for the most recent pause. Null for unknown historical reasons and shared viewers. Does not indicate whether resume is currently allowed.

pausedAt.description: Time the pause completed. Null while pausing, for older records or shared viewers.

AcceptSharedBrowser.description: Account authorization plus one invitation credential. Token read from URL fragment and removed immediately. Store a server-side pending authorization handle bound to the login transaction when redirecting to sign-in; never put the bearer secret in OAuth state, returnTo, query strings, analytics or localStorage.

prorationDate.description: Required for Basic to Pro; use value from upgrade-preview.

autoPause.description: Automatically pause after 5 minutes without a live CDP or desktop connection, including Console previews. Disable for disconnected background tasks. Creating, resuming or re-enabling starts a fresh 5-minute window. Does not override billing limits.

mode.description: allow-all permits websites except listed domains; allow-list blocks other websites; block-all blocks website network access. Management connections remain available.

domains.description: Connection hostnames or *.example.com (apex and all subdomains). HTTP/2 may reuse an allowed connection for another compatible hostname. This does not guarantee a per-URL host allowlist. No URLs, IPs, paths or ports. Nonempty for allow-list; empty for block-all.
